notes: Periods are enforced now instead of only asked for. Texts: no period at the end of a message, and a text written like "Hey. I saw your message. See you at 5." arrives as three quick bubbles with no periods, the way people actually text. A short cold reply like "ok." keeps its period on purpose, and "..." is left alone. Story: spoken lines lose their ending period, except the very last line of the reply.
